messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert PD-INC-7812 fired for service=inference-gateway-usw2 — 5xx error rate > 5% (1m). Trigger: gateway.http.5xx_rate > 0.05. Paging @ops-oncall
incident-bot: Incident created PD-INC-7812 — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx
Aisha: acked. I'm on it, pulling graphs now.
Aisha: dashboard -> https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/gateway/overview?orgId=1&var-region=usw2 — spike starts ~2024-04-16T15:12Z. 502/504 dominated, origin auth-proxy p99 up.
Connor: I see a weird throb pattern — small spikes every ~20s, matches p99 latencies from auth-proxy.
Marta: any customer-facing impact yet? Support: 3 customer reports, appears intermittent.
Aisha: running quick pod checks to narrow down: `kubectl get pods -n prod-gateway | grep auth-proxy`
Aisha: restarting auth-proxy deployment to see if it's transient.
Aisha: ```sh
kubectl -n prod-gateway rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy
kubectl -n prod-gateway get pods -l app=auth-proxy -w\```
Connor: auth-proxy logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts around the spike windows: "tls: handshake error: EOF" — could be upstream cert reneg or socket churn.
Marta: flagging support ticket and sending customer IDs to SRE for follow-up.
Aisha: after restart, 5xx rate dropped from ~6.2% -> ~2.1% over ~90s. Keeping an eye for recurrence.
pagerbot: PD: alert auto-resolved (condition recovered).
Connor: I'll watch for the next 30m in case this fades back. Aisha handing off.
Aisha: Handoff notes: likely transient auth-proxy TLS/keepalive issue. If it comes back, collect `tcpdump` on auth-proxy frontend, capture TLS errors, and consider routing to us-east1 fallback. Posting logs + runbook steps to incident doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/PD-INC-7812
Marta: Support will update customers with a brief status note and ETA for follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-7812 closed (no further pages). Owner: Connor.
Connor: will open a postmortem if it recurs. For now ops clear. :thumbsup:
